messages:
maria_cs: FYI — Solstice Health go-live next Tue. They flagged the latency SLO (p99 <= 350ms) in the onboarding contract but our onboarding traces show 420ms spikes during dataset imports. Need triage, a customer comms draft, and a credit estimate. @ajay_sre @leo_fin @priya_legal @tom_ae

ajay_sre: On it. Can you drop a sample trace or the timeframe? I want to see if this is sustained or just the bulk import windows. Might be cache warm-up + batching mismatch.

maria_cs: Pasting the two offending traces from last night (10:12pm and 10:43pm) — we saw a cluster of p99 ~420ms for embedding calls.
```
10:12:03 GET /v1/generate p99 422ms host:redwood-dedicated-2
10:12:04 DB read 120ms; model decode 260ms; queue wait 40ms
10:43:21 GET /v1/generate p99 418ms host:redwood-dedicated-2
10:43:22 DB read 110ms; model decode 255ms; cache miss
```

tom_ae: Heads-up — Solstice is on a renewal cadence in 10 weeks. If this becomes a pattern they will start flagging it in procurement. We should be conservative with credits but transparent.

leo_fin: Preliminary thought on credits: we usually follow the SLA credit banding in the contract. Quick calc options:
- If observed p99 <= 350ms -> 0% credit
- 350ms < p99 <= 450ms -> 5% credit (one-time)
- p99 > 450ms -> 10% credit + remediation plan
I can run exact dollars if we anchor to their monthly committed spend.

priya_legal: Can you paste the exact SLA clause? Most contracts cap credits at the monthly invoice or a fixed %; need to confirm language before we promise anything. Also watch wording around "systemic" vs "one-off" breaches.

ajay_sre: Quick mitigation suggestions: enable prefix KV caching for the onboarding job (low risk), throttle concurrent bulk imports or put them in a dedicated window, and enable the fallback model variant with lower latency for interactive traffic. I can roll a short config change tonight to test.

maria_cs: Thanks. Action plan I propose: 1) @ajay_sre run cache + throttle test tonight and report delta, 2) @leo_fin produce a capped credit proposal in $ and % (based on current invoice), 3) @priya_legal confirm permissible language for external comms, 4) I will draft an external note for Solstice with mitigations + proposed credit (aim: 10am TOM).

leo_fin: I will prepare two options in $: a conservative one-time credit (5% of monthly) and a capped remediation credit (max 10% if recurrence in 30 days). Will share numbers in the morning.

priya_legal: Fine with draft approach. Approve the comms if it frames credit as "goodwill credit per contract terms" and includes a remediation timeline. Avoid admitting platform-wide failure; describe as "latency variance observed during onboarding imports." :+1:

tom_ae: I will pre-brief the customer success exec sponsor and Procurement so they see we have a concrete remediation + limited credit. I can also discuss Dedicated capacity bump if they want guaranteed headroom — could be a renewal upsell path.

maria_cs: Perfect. Please post test results and Leo's numbers in this thread. I'll attach the external draft once ready and request sign-off. Thanks all :thumbsup:
